services.name: Boat rental
services.desc: Lake Union is the heart of Seattle, loved by locals and visitors alike. Our donut boats are the easiest way to hit the water and be at the center of it

blurb: Guests rent donut boats that are easy to drive with no experience needed. They can bring their own donuts (BYOD) and cruise Lake Union at their own pace. The company offers two-hour rentals and optional cheese plates for the ride.
extraNote: Open weekends in April weather permitting; midweek by appointment only · Open 7 days a week starting May 1st · Docks in front of the White Swan Pub and Eatery at 1001 Fairview Ave N, South Lake Union
